info.title: API.SH: OpenCritic
info.description: The OpenCritic API from API.SH: public OpenCritic data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Games by platform and period, sorted by score, release date or number of reviews, 20 a page: id, name, link, Top Critic Average, Critics Recommend percentage, tier, review count, first release date, platforms, genres and image. Narrow to one genre or tag with `genre` (echoed in the response). Use time=upcoming for upcoming releases and a year for the best games of that year. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/opencritic-browse

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: all (default), ps5, ps4, xbxs, xb1, switch, switch-2, pc, quest, psvr, vive, stadia, wii-u, 3ds, vita.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: all-time (default), last90 (released in the last 90 days), upcoming, or a year such as 2024.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Only games with this genre or tag: action, adventure, anime, arcade, beat-em-up, card-game, casual, co-op, comedy, family-friendly, fantasy, fighting, hack-and-slash, horror, indie, jrpg, mmo, multiplayer, open-world, platformer, puzzle, rpg, racing, retro, roguelike, sci-fi, shooter, side-scroller, simulation, singleplayer, souls-like, sports, stealth, story-rich, strategy, survival, turn-based, vr, visual-novel (`tag` is accepted too).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
